Lena M: Sundance wants to run a POC for multilingual embeddings + short-chat using a 13B variant. Requirements: EU-only data, FIPS KMS, deterministic tokenization for legal redaction, p95 < 120ms, and committed pricing for 6mo Dedicated if POC successful.
Kofi (Sales): Do they insist on Dedicated immediately or open to hosted first to prove numbers? Any qps targets?
Lena M: They prefer Dedicated for compliance but will consider hosted POC. Target peak ~50–60 qps, typical 100-200 tokens per request.
Anton (eng-ml): Feasible. Suggest hosted smoke with quantized 13B (llama-13b-q4f16) to measure p95 and cost. Deterministic tokenization: easiest is client-side normalization; server-side artifact pinning requires Dedicated/Private.
Kofi (Sales): Can you run a short hosted smoke and give ballpark costs we can put in the exec one-pager?
Anton (eng-ml): Plan: 1h soak, 10k embeddings + 2k chat turns. Metrics: p95, tokens, KV cache hit. Ballpark costs: hosted POC ~$1.5kor a month-scale soak; Dedicated 8x A100-equivalent reserve ~$18ky month depending on term.
Rita (security): FIPS KMS available only on Dedicated/Private with customer-managed KMS. Hosted uses cloud KMS (non-FIPS). Also ask Sundance for security contact and their questionnaire. We can offer 90-day audit log retention as an add-on.
Lena M: I'll get security contact and a 1k-line sample corpus. Anton: can you start the hosted smoke once we have the corpus?
Anton (eng-ml): Yes. ETA: start same day corpus arrives, deliver results in few hours. Note: cold vs warm cache will affect p95 significantly. For deterministic tests, use client-side tokenizer shim and attach normalized payloads.
ops-bot: infra note: ticket INF-2245 created for Dedicated sizing review.
Kofi (Sales): Thanks all. Action items: Lena collect contact + corpus; Anton run hosted smoke; Rita prepare security answers + add-on pricing; I'll draft the exec one-pager. Will loop in AE/legal.
